# Sansoft

> Sansoft Web Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a digital marketing agency based in Nagpur, India. We help businesses with SEO, local SEO, Google Ads, paid social, content, creative design and web development.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.sansoftonline.com/): Overview of Sansoft and its digital marketing services.
- [Services](https://www.sansoftonline.com/services/): Full service directory.
- [SEO Packages](https://www.sansoftonline.com/seo-packages/): One-time SEO package options and deliverables.
- [Google Ads Packages](https://www.sansoftonline.com/google-ads-packages/): Google Ads package options.
- [Social Media Ads Packages](https://www.sansoftonline.com/social-media-ads-packages/): Paid social package options.
- [Portfolio](https://www.sansoftonline.com/our-portfolio/): Selected client work.
- [Insights](https://www.sansoftonline.com/blog/): Articles on SEO and digital marketing.
- [Contact](https://www.sansoftonline.com/contact-us/): Contact details and enquiry form.
